reason: This passage from Exodus 11-12 depicts the final plague and the Exodus from Egypt. The Israelites are shown complying with Moses's instructions ('The Israelites did as Moses said,' וּבְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עָשׂ֖וּ כִּדְבַ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה), gathering the requested items of silver and gold, preparing provisions, and departing from Egypt in obedience. There is no expression of ingratitude toward either their leaders or Yahweh; instead, the passage demonstrates compliance and acceptance of God's deliverance.
